name: JellyFetch
description: Automatically scrapes, orchestrates cloud downloads, and injects them directly into your Jellyfin library. Fully automatic UI install - no manual web file setup required.
overview: A powerful plugin built for Indian users (with 1tamilmv integration) to seamlessly download and organize media.

versions.changelog: v1.2.0: Phase 1 Complete. Tabbed modern dashboard UI, manual magnet downloads with provider selection (Auto / Seedr / Torbox) & Activity auto-navigation, fallback download routing to configured directory, smooth movie detail button animations & hover transitions, friendly low-peer alert cards, scraper domain auto-discovery status badge & backup mirror override, and language cleanup improvements.
